payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methodologies and metrics used to evaluate the quality of the data, including sanity checks and BLEU score calculations for translations.

claims.text: The quality of the data is empirically evaluated using sentence-level BLEU scores to compare human translations with automatic translations, along with manual inspections of low-scoring translations.
An evaluation set is constructed from Tatoeba, filtering samples to ensure they are of adequate length and quality, which enhances the challenge and realism of the evaluation.
Quality checks are applied to both CoVoST and Tatoeba datasets, ensuring that no poor quality translations are included according to established criteria.
